office_does: A Court of Appeals judge hears and decides appeals from the superior courts; this District 2 seat covers Grays Harbor and five other western Washington counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Erik D. Price, on the Court of Appeals since 2021, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge since 2021 and Acting Chief Judge of Division II since 2026; Thurston County Superior Court judge from 2012 to 2021. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Court of Appeals judge since 2021; Acting Chief Judge since 2026 [S1]
Thurston County Superior Court judge 2012-2021, including presiding judge and three years as Adult Drug Court chief judge [S1]
Nineteen years in civil litigation in private practice [S1]
